name: Git Workflow
description: Inspect status, branch, and diff first. Commit or switch branches only when asked, and never force or reset.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the working tree before any git mutation.
Read the diff that would be committed.
Read recent commits before writing a message.
Read the current branch before checkout.
Create a commit only when the user asked.
Switch or create a branch only when the user asked.

validation.rule: git_status and git_diff were read before completion, and no reset, clean, force, or push was run.
